title: Interest Rate Buydown: Remaining Subsidy at Payoff, Refinance or Assumption
content:
**Clause.** If the loan is paid off or refinanced while subsidy remains, the remaining buydown subsidy balance of the Interest Rate Buydown is credited to the borrower, never returned to the seller or builder. On an approved assumption the remaining subsidy follows the loan instead. Points of a permanent buydown are never refunded.

**Effect on the records.** A funded buydown whose loan is paid off or refinanced while subsidy remains moves to **terminated early** status and shows the date it got there. The remaining balance leaves the custodial account as a **refund**, with the reason loan paid off or loan refinanced as the case may be.

| Event while subsidy remains | Remaining subsidy | Buydown status |
|---|---|---|
| loan paid off | credited to the borrower | terminated early |
| loan refinanced | credited to the borrower | terminated early |
| approved assumption | follows the loan | — |

| Permanent buydown | Points refunded |
|---|---|
| any event after closing | never |

### Cases (hypothetical)

- A seller funded a temporary buydown; at a refinance $2,511.00 of subsidy remains. The $2,511.00 is credited to the borrower; nothing is returned to the seller.
- The same loan is instead taken over under an approved assumption: the $2,511.00 remaining subsidy follows the loan.
- A borrower who paid $6,400.00 of points for a Larkspur Two-Point Permanent Buydown pays the loan off: the points are not refunded.
